title: Plague Doctor Spellcaster
description: A plague doctor-like figure with a bird mask and ornate crown sits beside a massive pile of black beetles and insects. The character holds an open book in one hand and levitates a glowing atomic symbol with the other, surrounded by floating golden rings, orbs, and scattered spell diagrams against a smoky dark background.
